title: Computers
body: Who doesn't like looking at the inside of computers? Among certain nerdy people, the traces, vias, solder joints, and symmetry highlight a perfectionism in these motherboards that is simply out of this world. It is probably the most underrated part of a PC. Developers try to save every bit of bandwidth and optimize the thickness of each trace. There is just so much to consider, and yet all that hard work goes unnoticed.
